title: Mary Kay: A Leader in the Beauty Product Industry
titleZh: 玫琳凯：美妆产品行业的领导者
credits: Nancy Steinbach wrote this story for VOA Special English. Anna Matteo adapted it for VOA Learning English.

sentences.en: Mary Kay Cosmetics is an international company that sells beauty products.
sentences.zh: 玫琳凯化妆品公司是一家销售美容产品的国际公司。

sentences.en: One woman started the business in the 1960s with an investment of $5,000.
sentences.zh: 一位女性在20世纪60年代以5000美元的投资创办了这家公司。

sentences.en: Mary Kathlyn Wagner was born in the state of Texas in 1918.
sentences.zh: 玫琳凯·瓦格纳于1918年出生在得克萨斯州。

sentences.en: For much of her childhood, she cared for her sick father while her mother worked long hours at a restaurant.
sentences.zh: 在她童年大部分时间里，她照顾生病的父亲，而母亲则在餐馆长时间工作。

sentences.en: Mary Kay married Ben Rogers when she was 17 years old.
sentences.zh: 玫琳凯17岁时与本·罗杰斯结婚。

sentences.en: They had three children before he left home to serve in World War Two.
sentences.zh: 他离家参加第二次世界大战前，他们育有三个孩子。

sentences.en: When he returned, their marriage ended.
sentences.zh: 当他归来时，他们的婚姻结束了。

sentences.en: Mary Kay looked for a job so she could support her children.
sentences.zh: 玫琳凯寻找工作以抚养她的孩子。

sentences.en: She began selling different kinds of products.
sentences.zh: 她开始销售各种各样的产品。

sentences.en: One night, Mary Kay was showing products at the home of Ova Heath Spoonemore.
sentences.zh: 一天夜里，玫琳凯在欧娃·希思·斯普恩莫雷家中展示产品。

sentences.en: Ms. Spoonemore began giving her guests some homemade skin care products.
sentences.zh: 斯普恩莫雷女士开始给她的客人一些自制的护肤品。

sentences.en: The products were developed by her father, J.W.
sentences.zh: 这些产品由她父亲J.W.

sentences.en: Heath, in Arkansas.
sentences.zh: 希思在阿肯色州研发。

sentences.en: Mary Kay tried the skin care products and liked them.
sentences.zh: 玫琳凯试用了这些护肤品并很喜欢。

sentences.en: She bought the rights to Heath’s skin care products and started her own company.
sentences.zh: 她购买了希思护肤品的权利并创办了自己的公司。

sentences.en: She paid $500 for the legal rights to the products.
sentences.zh: 她为这些产品的合法权利支付了500美元。

sentences.en: And in 1963, The Mary Kay Cosmetics company began operating in Dallas, Texas.
sentences.zh: 1963年，玫琳凯化妆品公司在得克萨斯州达拉斯开始运营。

sentences.en: The idea was to sell skin care products through demonstrations in homes and offices.
sentences.zh: 其理念是通过在家庭和办公室的演示来销售护肤品。

sentences.en: Independent sales representatives bought beauty products from the company and sold them at higher prices.
sentences.zh: 独立销售代表从公司购买美容产品，再以更高的价格出售。

sentences.en: Mary Kay decided that each representative who brought other saleswomen into the company would receive part of the new person’s earnings.
sentences.zh: 玫琳凯决定，每位引入其他女销售员加入公司的代表将获得新人收入的一部分。

sentences.en: That way, experienced sales representatives would be willing to train new ones.
sentences.zh: 这样一来，经验丰富的销售人员就愿意培训新人了。

sentences.en: By 1965, the company was selling almost one million dollars in products.
sentences.zh: 到1965年，这家公司的产品销售额已接近100万美元。

sentences.en: Mary Kay Cosmetics became one of the most successful direct sellers of skin care products in America.
sentences.zh: 玫琳凯化妆品公司成为美国最成功的护肤品直销商之一。

sentences.en: It continues to have sales offices and representatives in many different countries.
sentences.zh: 它至今在许多不同国家都设有销售办事处和代表。

sentences.en: Mary Kay aimed to grow sales based on the idea that it is best to compete against yourself.
sentences.zh: 玫琳凯致力于以“与自我竞争最为理想”的理念来扩大销售。

sentences.en: That means every individual is trying to beat their own sales records.
sentences.zh: 这意味着每个人都在努力打破自己的销售纪录。

sentences.en: Prizes for high sales marks included special paid holidays and jewelry.
sentences.zh: 针对高销售额设置的奖励包括特别的带薪假期和珠宝。

sentences.en: Until a few years ago, a pink Cadillac was a top prize.
sentences.zh: 直到几年前，一辆粉色凯迪拉克仍是最丰厚的奖品。

sentences.en: After her third husband, Mel Ash, died of cancer in 1980, she wanted to help find a cure for the disease.
sentences.zh: 在第三位丈夫梅尔·阿什于1980年因癌症去世后，她希望能帮助找到治愈这种疾病的方法。

sentences.en: At first, she helped organizations raise money for research.
sentences.zh: 起初，她帮助各组织为研究筹款。

sentences.en: Later, she started the Mary Kay Ash Charitable Foundation, a nonprofit group that provides money to support research on cancers affecting women.
sentences.zh: 后来，她创立了玫琳凯·阿什慈善基金会，这是一个为非营利组织，为支持针对女性癌症的研究提供资金。

sentences.en: In 2001, the company and foundation expanded their goals to help prevent violence against women.
sentences.zh: 2001年，该公司和基金会扩大了其目标，以帮助预防针对女性的暴力。

sentences.en: Mary Kay Ash also wrote three books.
sentences.zh: 玫琳凯·阿什还撰写了三本书。

sentences.en: She worked in her business until she suffered a stroke in 1996.
sentences.zh: 她从事自己的事业，直到1996年罹患中风。

sentences.en: She died in 2001.
sentences.zh: 她于2001年去世。

sentences.en: Sales representatives say Mary Kay developed a way for women to earn money and still spend time with their families.
sentences.zh: 销售人员表示，玫琳凯为女性提供了一种既能赚钱又能陪伴家人的方式。

glossary.def: A problem with one or more blood vessels that prevents the brain from getting enough blood
glossary.zh: 中风;脑卒中;脑血管意外
